fit_reason: Whole sailboat (1986 Catalina Capri 18) on trailer, listed by a private seller.
findings: Topsides gelcoat looks generally white and clean, but the starboard hull side in the trailer photo shows some dullness and uneven reflection along the upper hull
Blue bottom paint near the waterline and boot stripe on the starboard side looks patchy and uneven in the trailer photo
Light scuffing and marks on the white cockpit seats and deck near the companionway
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Capri 18. The boat looks well cared for, and the hull side in the trailer shot has a bit of dullness a gelcoat polish and wax would brighten up, plus a few scuffs around the cockpit seats. We do pre-sale gelcoat polish and detailing and come to you. Would you like a quote?
